name: ULTRON - KSP Police Command Center
description: Datathon 2026 project. Police command center app with real-time crime mapping, FIR tracking, patrol allocation, and predictive analytics.

hellcat.description: Build and implementation agent. Writes production-quality code, implements features, fixes bugs, refactors code, optimizes performance, and runs tests.

ghost.description: Strategic planning agent. Analyzes requirements, breaks down tasks, creates implementation plans, designs architecture, and produces task breakdowns before any code is written.

viper.description: Documentation and writing agent. Creates README files, API docs, inline code documentation, API reference generation, changelogs, and technical writing.

raven.description: Operations and DevOps agent. Manages Git operations, GitHub workflows, deployments, CI/CD, release management, branch strategy, and repository maintenance.

dev.template: Run the frontend development server: cd /mnt/e/Datathon-2026-ULTRON/frontend && npm run dev

build.template: Build the frontend: cd /mnt/e/Datathon-2026-ULTRON/frontend && npm run build

lint.template: Run the frontend linter: cd /mnt/e/Datathon-2026-ULTRON/frontend && npm run lint

deploy.template: Build frontend and deploy the application. Check DEPLOYMENT.md for deployment instructions. Run build verification first.
